name: pharaoh_building_refresh_money_values

source_reuse.contract: The highest building id is reloaded after every callback.

typed_contract: The 264-byte building array, live volatile highest-id pointer and real money-value provider are explicit. Active records clear DWORD +0xB8; only records with BYTE +0x05 equal to zero call the provider. The highest id is reloaded after the provider before every loop continuation.

verification.strict_compile: MSVC Win32 /Zs /std:c11 /O2 /W4 /WX passed for type_queries.c, finance_money.c and x87_numeric.c

remaining_gap: The three native callers and actual Windows-host assembly of the live finance provider context remain separate. Invalid pointer/fault domains and incidental registers/flags are not qualified.
